title: Adaptive Monitoring and Real-World Evaluation of Agentic AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptually monitored through the 'Safety & Ethics' evaluation axis of the proposed Adaptive Multi-Dimensional Monitoring (AMDM) framework, which uses exponentially weighted moving-average (EWMA) thresholds and Mahalanobis distance to flag joint anomalies (including fairness and bias violations) in streaming logs of agentic AI workflows.
